policy.source_of_truth: Each project's own repository and runtime remain authoritative; this central register tracks provenance and closure evidence only.
policy.closure_rule: A finding may be marked PASS only when its linked correction commit and its regression test pass are verified on the final commit. A green CI run on another SHA does not close it.
policy.isolation: Findings are keyed by project_id and front. Dark War REA and Guerra Infinita development share a strategic product line but remain separate research and development fronts, branches, artifacts, and pipelines.
policy.no_authority: This registry does not authorize merge, deploy, publication, deletion, secrets, permissions, DNS, production writes, paid resources, or external communications.

findings.title: Authentication, authorization and password-reset concurrency findings require source-level revalidation
evidence: On main, PasswordResetRepository::resetPassword() selects an unused token inside a transaction without FOR UPDATE, consumes it with an unconditional UPDATE by id, and does not verify affected-row counts; this leaves the one-time token race identified by the audit.

PR #12 adds SELECT ... FOR UPDATE, conditional token consumption with exactly-one-row verification, account-update row-count validation and rollback on failure; CI run #178 passed on exact head 0b7fd05fc393275a2435acf9a8510831417f8da5.
PR #17 adds a two-process concurrency test against disposable MySQL requiring exactly one SUCCESS and one REJECTED; CI run #185 passed on exact head 04502c03be706188ce6ab79fb4827f9310c5a607.

PR #20 revokes active sessions in the same transaction as password reset and adds a MySQL session-revocation integration test; CI run #190 passed on exact head 3b990a982a6c73f2e9d6829c556a3cdefec0753b.

On main, RateLimiterService::hit() allows requests when storage creation/opening/locking fails or invalid limits are supplied. PR #18 changes these paths to deny; CI run #186 passed on exact head a4f77e443caa1bf8a5158f98ae6abf0c8e1f0a60, stacked on PR #7.

On main, config/jwt.php falls back to the known local placeholder secret when JWT_SECRET is absent, and config/cors.php defaults CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS to '*'; no production fail-closed validation was found in the inspected configuration path. These remain unchanged in the shared-hardening PR #7 branch.

The AuthMiddleware class returns true, but the inspected Router does not wire it; protected controller actions use BaseController::requireAuth() and Jwt::decode(). The stub is not counted as a confirmed bypass.
All referenced PRs remain open; PR #7 is ready for review but unmerged, while PRs #12, #17, #18 and #20 are drafts. Green CI on stacked branches does not remediate main.

regression_test.test: Run the disposable-MySQL concurrent reset test and session-revocation test on the final integrated commit; add production-config tests proving missing JWT_SECRET and CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS fail closed; verify rate-limit storage failure denies requests.

closure_gate: Integrate the password-reset atomic-consumption, MySQL concurrency, and session-revocation changes only through their reviewed PR chain; no merge is performed here.
Make production JWT configuration reject missing or placeholder JWT_SECRET instead of silently using the local fallback.
Make production CORS configuration reject missing or wildcard origins unless a separately approved public-only policy explicitly requires it.
Integrate the fail-closed rate-limiter change and add trusted-proxy tests for the source IP and tenant dimensions used by rate limiting.
Run all relevant PHP, web, mobile and disposable-MySQL workflows on the exact final commit and independently verify the regressions.

findings.title: Payment confirmation, recovery and JSON persistence concurrency findings need source-level revalidation
evidence: On main, POST /carrinho, GET /carrinho, GET /checkout, GET /stream/checkout and POST /finalizar are registered without authentication middleware; payment preference is also public by design and therefore needs cart-capability authorization rather than ordinary operator auth.
storeController.getCartId() accepts x-cart-id, query cartId or body cartId directly from the caller; cartService.resolveCartId() maps a missing ID to the shared key 'default'.
cartService derives the sale channel from patterns in the caller-controlled cart ID, so the channel is not server-owned. Checkout preview and the SSE stream use that caller-controlled identifier.

On the current PR #1 branch, POST /finalizar returns HTTP 410 and maquininha initiation/confirmation require an authenticated operational role, but cart ownership/capability, shared-default removal and server-owned channel are explicitly documented as remaining release blockers rather than implemented fixes.

The repository readDb()/writeDb() implementation still reads and overwrites the complete database.json synchronously without a transaction, inter-process lock or atomic revision check; the PostgreSQL repository in PR #1 is a separate prototype and is not wired into the live repository adapter.

PR #1 head 191de885af6f3506260522eeabf2897ee1b8982a is draft and mergeable; Backend QA run #91 completed SUCCESS on that exact head. CI does not prove live Render persistence, live backup, cart ownership or real Mercado Pago sandbox behavior.

PR #1's own release gates state that Render Free local filesystem data is ephemeral and no authorized live export/backup path was found. No live data or secrets were read and no infrastructure action was taken.

regression_test.path: backend/scripts/smoke_test.js; synthetic cart-capability integration tests; multi-process persistence tests; backup/restore rehearsal
regression_test.test: With two independent synthetic clients, verify that cart A cannot read, mutate, stream, checkout or pay cart B; missing cart credentials never resolve to a shared cart; channel is server-owned; payment preference and confirmation are idempotent; concurrent persistence mutations do not lose updates; backup restore reproduces the exact synthetic dataset.

closure_gate: Implement a cart capability with a non-secret public locator and high-entropy secret; never trust a caller-supplied cart ID alone and remove the shared 'default' cart.
Bind cart reads, writes, SSE, checkout and payment preference to the capability; issue short-lived stream tickets or use authenticated polling.
Keep maquininha initiation and confirmation restricted to authenticated operational roles; verify NSU/authorization and reject duplicate settlement.
Keep Mercado Pago webhook signature, amount, order, collector and currency checks fail closed; run sandbox integration only with explicitly configured test credentials.
Replace live JSON whole-file persistence with an isolated transactional adapter and multi-process concurrency tests; do not use the prototype as proof of runtime wiring.
Preserve/export live data and complete a restore rehearsal before any restart, redeploy, storage change or migration; current live backup path remains BLOCKED.
Run all regression tests on the exact final commit; no merge, deployment, production write or live-data access is implied.

findings.title: Cross-company employee/document isolation requires source-level revalidation
evidence: rh_documentos.php lists active users at line 200 and all non-deleted documents at line 207 without filtering by the authenticated session's empresa_id.

Document validation at lines 63-69 updates by funcionario_id and tipo only; upload at lines 149-160 derives empresa_id from the submitted target funcionario_id; deletion at line 189 updates by funcionario_id and tipo only. None verifies the target employee belongs to the authenticated user's company.

rh_ponto.php requires only the global ver_cartao_ponto permission; it lists all pessoas at line 75 and all matching rh_ponto rows through queries at lines 126-148 without an empresa_id predicate. Insert at line 40 omits empresa_id and deletion at line 61 uses only the point-row ID.

rh_ferias.php requires only the global definir_ferias permission; it lists all users at line 68, lists vacation records at lines 82-90 without empresa_id, inserts without empresa_id at line 38, and deletes by row ID at line 53.

pessoas.php lists and searches the pessoas table at lines 64-77 without empresa_id. pessoa_cadastrar.php inserts people without setting empresa_id. The foundation migration adds empresa_id to pessoas, rh_documentos, rh_ferias and rh_ponto, but these existing write/read paths do not consistently use it.
dossie_colaborador.php allows managers with global RH permissions to choose from all active users at lines 24-34 without restricting the list to the session company.
seguranca.php refreshes the user's empresa_id into the session, but the inspected HR queries and mutations do not consistently enforce that scope.

This is a source-level cross-company isolation failure across employee, document, time and vacation modules. No employee data, live database rows, or document contents were accessed; no two-company runtime test has been executed.

regression_test.path: two-company synthetic MySQL integration suite covering rh_documentos.php, rh_ponto.php, rh_ferias.php, pessoas.php and dossie_colaborador.php
regression_test.test: Create two companies with separate HR managers and employees. Verify each manager can only list, create, validate, delete and view employees/documents/time/vacations in their own company; verify all new records persist the authenticated empresa_id; test cross-company IDs and row IDs are rejected.

closure_gate: Use the authenticated user's empresa_id as the only tenant scope; never derive authorization from a submitted funcionario_id or row ID.
Add empresa_id to every relevant SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE in documents, time, vacation, people and dossier flows; preserve global super-admin access only through an explicit audited policy.
For document operations, verify the employee and document empresa_id match the session company in the mutation statement itself.
For point and vacation creation, write the authorized empresa_id and validate the employee belongs to that company before insert.
Restrict dossier employee pickers and data loaders to the session company.
Add two-company synthetic MySQL tests for read, create, update, delete and IDOR-style cross-company IDs.
Run all PHP lint and relevant integration tests; inspect remaining RH pages for tenant predicates before marking PASS.
